blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: Is Sunshine Hills Woods one official City neighbourhood?
faq.a: No. The Paragon name combines two neighbourhoods named in the former North Delta Area Plan (Schedule C.1, Bylaw No. 3950) — Sunshine Hills (12 of 14) and Sunshine Woods (13 of 14) — and the City publishes no single boundary for the combined name.

faq.q: What is the large park in the area?
faq.a: Watershed Park at 11600 Kittson Pkwy, described by the City as Delta's largest park, with eleven kilometres of gravel trails for walking, cycling, jogging and horseback riding per the City page.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Sunshine Hills Woods address?
faq.a: It depends on the address. The SD37 locator result for 11285 Bond Blvd is Sunshine Hills Elementary (K–7) and Seaquam Secondary (8–12); there is no middle tier in SD37, and catchments for other addresses must be checked in the locator.

faq.q: Which bus runs on Kittson Parkway?
faq.a: Route 340, running between Scottsdale Exchange and 22nd Street Station via 64 Avenue, Kittson Parkway, Highway 91 and the Alex Fraser Bridge.

faq.q: Can a house lot here add a garden suite?
faq.a: Delta's SSMUH regulations allow garden suites and coach houses in combination with single detached and duplex dwellings where the zoning applies — confirm the parcel's zone under Bylaw No. 7600 first.
